name: To Open the Doors of the Firmament
description: The waters above are locked away behind the Firmament, but with proper supplication to the angels who control those doors you can convince them to open them just a moment and cause a rainstorm.  This charm requires that you sacrifice a chicken to enact it.

name: To Shut the Lion's Mouth
description: While there are other more pressing dangers now, wild animals are still a threat after the Cataclysm.  By entreating the aid of the angels who rule over dangerous creatures, you can prevent nearby wild animals from attacking you.
message: "By the name of Methenail, and by the name of Aphethial, and by the name of Vobehielael, who hold dominion over the beasts of the wild, I abjure thee".
//: This has no components but is very limited in scope.
